name: }IDE.ReprocessFeeders
description: Re-run the feeders for one cube (CubeProcessFeeders). The IDE runs it on a target after a deploy for every cube whose rules the release changed, because TM1 v11 has no REST call for it and cross-cube feeders do not re-arm on their own.

parameters.Name: pCube
parameters.Prompt: The cube whose feeders are reprocessed.
